question.prompt: The incenter of \(\triangle ABC\) is \(I\). Given \(\angle A=50^\circ\) and \(\angle B=60^\circ\), find the measure of \(\angle AIB\) (in degrees).

solutions.explanation: \(AI\) and \(BI\) bisect \(\angle A\) and \(\angle B\), respectively. Thus \(\angle IAB+\angle IBA=25^\circ+30^\circ=55^\circ\), so \(\angle AIB=180^\circ-55^\circ=125^\circ\).
solutions.title: Use the angle bisectors
